findings.detail: All32 native blocks and48 inputs read individually. Internal24 portions3595A1 throughAQ at E7; finalAW3308H1,AX3308J1,AY3308K1 at H6; AZ0516C1 U03AR at J6. ST AR T06AA pinsB10/B13/B03/D05, named starred outputs plain; separate upper unnamed outputs drive first A U03AA unnamed inputs. FirstA enableB09. Second A has ONLY reset4D09 and feedbackD10/D12/B02/B07, all plain. OR OR U03CL outputD06/D11/D02/B05 border-wedge. Four additional OR DOT primitives BE/BF/BG/BH carry only K-C2 and4B/4E/4H/4L, no invented card data; both unnamed inputs and unnamed output source border-wedges. N U03AF inputD06/D11/D02/B05 wedge; outputsD10starT/D12starT/B02starT/B07starT plain. AR U55AC plain inputsD10/D12/B02/B07 and wedge outputsB12/D13/B04/D04. FinalN wedge inputsB13/D12/B12/D04, plain outputsD11star/D10star/B10star/B02star. All literal grids match.

GT FD921AL4 rail drives AE/AG/AJ/AL B09; RESET FD921AF4 drives AF/AH/AK/AM4D09. Each ST separate upper output feeds firstA, each firstA and secondA output feeds its OR OR input. OR OR named wedge output enters DOT upper input; separate SET FD921AU4/AV4/AW4/AX4 rail enters DOT lower input, crossing upper wire without diamond. DOT output enters N. Each N starredT output has native diamonds joining AR plain input, secondA feedback and external parity AS4/AT4/AU4/AV4. AR wedge output enters finalN wedge; finalN plain starred output enters indicator. Named ST output forwards bus parity separately. All48 physical inputs have exactly one owner and unjoined crossings preserved.

Bus P32-39/P40-47/P 48-55/P56-63 originsFE331AY4/FE141AF4/FE221AF4/FE331AR4 with RT625BX4/BY4,RT635BX4/BY4. GT T P0diamondP1diamondP2diamondP3 TO DAR MASK and RST name separators are literal text, not junctions. First2 forwardFS311, last2FS361; all indicatorsKT472. First IND name00-07 uses hyphen; later IND names08 TO15,16 TO23,24 TO31. Parity refsBF571/BF561/BF631/BF591. Captions DAR MASK P0-7 andP8-15, lower DARMASK P16-23/P24-31. No invented spaces or references.

All24 connector strings (12 named references and12 continuations) checked in native three-column table: AA/AB/AC/AD B3D10/D11/D12/D13 and B1M4 continuations; AS A6D10→A2A6D10,AT A6D11→A2A6D11,AU B7D10→B2N7D10,AV A7D11→B2N7D11,AW B7D10→A4M6D10,AX B7D11→A4M6D11,AY B6D10→A4M7D10,AZ B6D11→A4M7D11.
